crossRefs.note: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”

translations.web: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
translations.bsb: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
translations.kjv: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite
translations.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.
